title: API gateway onboarding: a bad partner file fixed and held for its merge
summary: A partner's gateway config file that breaks the repository's rules starts "Onboard a config file" (onboard_config_file, #329): BOSS runs the repository's checker, fixes what the ruleset lets an agent fix, reviews it, and stops at the merge card for a person. The journey account never approves, so the chain after the merge (staging, contract tests, the production approval) runs only once a person merges; covering it daily needs a separate approver principal for the fixture project, not the journey account.

fixtures: examples/api-gateway-onboarding reset onto a fixture repo the fixture project builds (reset.sh), with config/tenants/lumen-pay.yaml as target_path and the bad file as start_from

acceptance.text: The fixed file passes the repository's checker
The run waits at the merge for a person
